ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Write to System32 Tasks
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of tasks from processes executed from suspicious locations

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks.*") AND (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\PerfLogs.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\config\\\\systemprofile.*")))
